watch.summary: A streamer passionately begs a pro Valorant player to pick Phoenix during a tournament draft while holding up his Phoenix action figure.

beats.what: The streamer excitedly begs pro player Asuna to pick Phoenix.
He repeatedly chants that he wants a Phoenix ace tonight.
He reaches down and pulls out a physical Phoenix action figure.
He proudly holds the Phoenix figure up right next to the webcam.
He lovingly kisses the action figure on the head.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I want a Phoenix ace tonight!
watch.why: The streamer's intense hype for a rare character pick reaches a funny visual peak when he pulls out a physical action figure to support the pick. It relies on Valorant esports context to get why picking Phoenix is significant.
